To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The current Internet has a host centric design and does not recognize data as an integral entity of the system.
we envision the next generation Internet as a dynamic, heterogeneous network that is flexible enough to support innovation and policy enforcements.

(a) the next generation internet should be policy oriented and flexible, (b) the naming and naming binding should be redesigned to accommodate policy enforcement, (c) the next generation should be based on a two part protocol stack and a virtualization layer between them, (d) a generalized end-point abstraction is necessary for the next generation internet, (e) the mapping and negotiation layer should be a generalized end-point, and (f) an integrated framework for policy enforcement is needed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an integrated framework for next generation Internet that is flexible and secure enough to support policy enforcement at the edge and core of the Internet.
a new vision of the future Internet and the design principles that will enable this new Internet to support the next generation of applications.
the design and implementation of a next generation internet with a focus on security, policy enforcement, naming and naming resolution, virtualization, and end-to-end communication.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the next generation internet is a network where the data, users, services, and applications are first class entities.

we are at a point where we need to rethink the design of the Internet and its architecture to support the new emerging technologies and applications and to enable the Internet to be a truly ubiquitous, dynamic, heterogeneous and secure network.
PONA is a vision of the next generation internet that is flexible, dynamic and secure and can be deployed in the current internet with minimal modifications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a policy oriented architecture and protocol stack for the next generation internet.
the next generation Internet will be policy aware.
the future Internet needs to be a dynamic and heterogeneous network flexible enough to enforce policies at the edge and at the core.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need a new design that will enable policy enforcement and innovation in the future internet.
the current Internet is not the best design for the next generation.
the next generation Internet will be a heterogeneous network with a virtualization and policy layer in between.
